dedupe_keys.name: from future learning to current action long term sequential infrastructure planning under uncertainty

description: From Future Learning to Current Action: Long-Term Sequential Infrastructure Planning under Uncertainty is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Yuchuan Lai, Tetra Tech (tetratech.com). This is the data repository for the "Sequential Learning of Climate Change via a Physical-parameter-based State-space Model and Bayesian Inference". Specifically, the datasets provided include the input files, simulations, and analysis results from the developed state space model (SSM). Additional details can be found at: Lai, Y. and M. Pozzi, (2023). Under Review. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: climate change, uncertainty, adaptation, bayesian inference. Published 2023-07-07. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
